PROFILE::fasthttp
       Returns the value of a Fast HTTP profile setting.

SYNOPSIS
       PROFILE::fasthttp ATTR

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned Fast HTTP profile.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned Fast HTTP profile.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.3 --First introduced the command.
